title: Diesel, Drones and Donald
summary:
Main
Image reference: assets/2026-10-26_diesel-drones-and-donald_img_tankerrr-2_89290ba50318.jpg
The Trump administration has been busy easing sanctions over the past couple of weeks. On 9 October, OFAC issued General License 135. It allows the sale, delivery and import into the US of Russian-origin diesel until 7 April 2027.
